req.title: Reject negative squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-023 requires HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer. The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that a negative kind test must not use EP as its heuristic; EP is reserved for positive (valid partition) tests or must be paired with a non-negative kind. Fix: change test[5] heuristic from EP to NEG, which correctly classifies it as a negative equivalence test targeting the invalid partition. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_positive_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
squadNumber=99 does not exist in the pre-loaded fixture
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload where squadNumber=99 (a clearly positive integer not in fixture)
expected: Response body contains squadNumber equal to 99
trace: R-PLAYER-023: positive integers must be accepted; EP representative from valid partition
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_positive_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"

test_positive_squad_number_returns_201()

tests.name: test_squad_number_one_returns_201_or_409
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
squadNumber=1 already exists in the pre-loaded fixture (Franco Armani)
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=1 (boundary: smallest positive integer, already in fixture so expect 409 conflict, NOT 422)
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict is returned (player with squad number 1 already exists)
Response status code is exactly 409, confirming the value was valid (not 422)
trace: R-PLAYER-023: BVA boundary+1 from zero — squadNumber=1 is the minimum positive integer; it must NOT be rejected with 422; fixture has squad 1 so 409 is expected, proving validation passed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_squad_number_one_returns_409_not_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Franco",
        "lastName": "Armani",
        "squadNumber": 1,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    assert r.status_code != 422

test_squad_number_one_returns_409_not_422()
